stem.text: Compound P displays *cis*/*trans* isomerism and gives a red-brown precipitate with Fehling's solution.

A.alt: Displayed formula: H, H, CH2CHO and CH3 attached to a C=C bond

B.alt: Displayed formula: H, H, COCH3 and CH3 attached to a C=C bond

C.alt: Displayed formula: H, H, CH3 and CHO attached to a C=C bond

D.alt: Displayed formula: CH3, H, H and CHO attached to a C=C bond
